# Tolworth Driving School

> Driving school in Tolworth, Surrey/South West London (KT5, KT6), part of Kings Driving Centre. Manual and automatic driving lessons, intensive courses, test cover and mock tests on the Tolworth Test Centre routes, taught by DVSA Approved Driving Instructors.

- Phone: 020 3143 1718 | WhatsApp: 07301 498451 | Email: info@kingsdrivingcentre.co.uk
- Postcode: KT6 4DU
- Hours: 7 days, 8am-8pm
- Parent brand: Kings Driving Centre (https://kingsdrivingcentre.co.uk/)
- Areas: Tolworth, Surbiton, Berrylands, Hook, Chessington, Long Ditton, Thames Ditton, Kingston upon Thames, New Malden, Motspur Park, Worcester Park, Stoneleigh, Ewell, Esher, Claygate, Raynes Park, Morden (SM4)
- Prices (same for manual and automatic): 1 hour £40; 2-hour beginner £75; 2-hour experienced £80; refresher £40/hr; blocks 10h £370, 20h £730, 30h £1,050 (£35/hr); intensive courses 10h £550, 20h £1,070, 30h £1,500 (+£150 optional test cover); test cover £130 (regular pupils) / £150 (urgent); mock test £80 (2 hours); Pass Plus £260 (6 hours)
- Payment: all major cards incl. American Express, Klarna; no card fees
- Instructors: DVSA Approved Driving Instructors, Enhanced DBS checked; dual-controlled, insured cars (Toyota Yaris, Toyota Yaris Cross, VW T-Cross)
